What is yaru-xfwm4-theme?

This package themes xfwm4, the window manager used by Xfce, with Yaru's window borders, title bars, and decorations so an Xfce session can visually match the rest of the Yaru desktop suite. It's for users pairing Xfce with Ubuntu's default theming rather than GNOME.

Install yaru-xfwm4-theme on Omarchy

official Omarchy package command
$ omarchy pkg add yaru-xfwm4-theme

Good to know

  • No special requirements documented.
